title: Pesa
tagline: Pesa helps people in Argentina to buy yield earning USDM and send money to friends via @handles.
description: Privy provides an easy onboarding experience which also offers the possibility to purchase tokens with Google and Apple Pay as well as through receiving funds via a wallet address. ENS subdomains enable easy transfer of funds inapp to friends trough @handles. USDM offers yield bearning protection against the ARS inflation. All self-custodial.
how_its_made:
Started with Privy PWA for simple email account creation. 
Usernames are deployed as an ENS L2 subdomain on Celo Alfajores.
Front-end was vibecoded with Cursor.
Subdomain Registry.sol was deployed manually due to other issues.
Solo hacking with non-dev non-engineering background.
